recall.minute: A decision tree is a set of if-then rules learned greedily. Entropy H = −Σ p log₂ p measures how mixed a node is; information gain is the drop in weighted entropy after a split, and ID3 picks the attribute with the largest gain, recursing until leaves are pure. On PlayTennis, Outlook (0.246) is the root, then Humidity under Sunny and Wind under Rain. Continuous attributes use the best midpoint threshold; Gini 1 − Σ p² is an alternative impurity; gain ratio corrects the bias toward many-valued attributes. Trees overfit, so limit growth, prune with a validation set, or use MDL to balance tree size against errors.
